summary: ```markdown # CLO6.2 New Feature: Live Replay ## Introduction Hello everyone, I am Andy from Cloud3D. Today, my colleague Nicole and I will introduce you to the new features of version 6.2. ## Overview of New Features The new features of version 6.2 are mainly based on four parts. Let's look at the first part, which includes five functions: 1. BGN's rain costume 2. Folding 3D costume 3. Riding horse 4. Replacement version 5. Using Colossus assets in CLO ### BGN's Rain Costume First, let's take a look at the first main function: BGN's rain costume. This function can create BGN's rain costume by setting fill and weight. We can see that this is the final presentation effect. #### Software Interface Open the corresponding project file and double-click to open it. This is a single-layer costume that has been created. We need to copy and fill it with the layer. 1. **Locating the Fill Tool**: Come to the main menu bar and click on the 2D panel to find the fill tool. Its position is here in the 2D window toolbar. 2. **Selection and Copying**: Make a selection of the fill tool using the cross-selection method. You can also press the Shift key to select all the fill tools. After selecting all the fill tools, the mouse will move, and the fill tool will move along with it. Next, we set the fill tool for the film. #### Setting Fill Tool Properties 1. **Selecting Fill Tool**: Press the Shift key and select the fill tool. Go to the property editor and look at the first column, which is the fill tool category. There are mainly two types of fill tools. 2. **Weight Input**: Enter the weight of the fill tool according to the requirements. When selecting multiple sheets, the total weight of the fill tool is assigned according to the ratio of the area. Next, enter the width of the air vent. If the air vent line is a regular equal distance, enter the number directly. If it is irregular, enter the maximum width of the air vent line. The fill tool size is calculated based on the weight of the fill tool and the width of the air vent. #### Simulation and Finalizing After setting the horizontal line of the sheet, we can simulate the fill effect. After stabilization, we change the model's posture to a vertical one and turn off the simulation. ### Folding 3D Clothing Next, we look at the second function: Folding 3D clothing. This function is primarily aimed at folding 3D clothing. 1. **Open the Project File**: Open the corresponding project file in the software interface. 2. **Tools Overview**: The upper corner will pop up a window with a foldable 3D costume. There are seven tools in it. #### Tool Functions - **Rotate X-axis**: This tool can rotate the 3D costume 90 degrees around the X-axis. - **Rotate Level**: This tool can place the costume face down. - **Optimize Quality**: This tool is used to effectively fold 3D costumes. ### Riding Horse Functionality The main function of this function is to switch the horse and simulate it. The simulation state of each horse will be automatically saved. 1. **Open the Project File**: Open the software interface and double-click to open it. You can see a link group with horse information. 2. **Size Matching**: Match each size with the virtual model. After matching, remember to simulate it. ### Replacement Version Functionality This function allows you to replace a specific version. 1. **Import Modified DXF Version**: Import the modified DXF version file into the software. 2. **Selecting and Replacing**: Select the front group, right-click, and copy it down. Then, come to the original version and right-click to replace the version. ### Using Colossus Assets in CLO This function allows you to download and use assets in the cloud. 1. **Connecting to Cloud Account**: Open the cloud software and connect to the cloud site platform account. 2. **Adding Cloud Assets**: Add some cloud assets to your account and collect items of interest. ## Modes ### Print and Release Mode The print and release mode has been completely updated with six new tools. 1. **Publish Tool**: This tool is mainly to publish the version in the fabric effectively. 2. **Arrangement Settings**: Set the current number of arrangements and the number of colors. ### Check the Size Mode This mode can compare the effects of different sizes of clothes on the same screen. ## Material Functions This part contains four functions: 1. **Printing Cloth**: This function adds three new options to the repeat type of the print image. 2. **Open File Information**: Selectively open the property information of the fabric. 3. **Increase Reflection**: Adjust reflection properties on fabrics. 4. **Genealogy Function**: Update the function for UV editing mode. ## Conclusion Thank you for your attention. This concludes our introduction to the new features in CLO version 6.2. ```
